role: Independent reviewer; no implementation, training or new-game dispatch

first in frozen test_seeds, not numerically smallest

sample_binding: Bind actual seed integers and deployed arm/opponent names after preregistration, before any outcome. Missing or unstarted samples are not replaced.
pre_review: Current clean public HEAD and all inherited model/controller/encoder/teacher/default/opponent/rule/loader identities; prior repair accepted, original training-stage filename failure unchanged.

Exactly eight unique explicit integer seeds in official domain; reproduce frozen generator and declared distribution. Conservative novelty scan includes current tracked public text and local recorded registration/config/manifest/ledger/result/summary/seed files, including market192 reserved tests. Scope and exclusions disclosed; no claim of global novelty.

Fixed candidate and hybrid reference use identical crop model and opportunity generation, candidate masks, protocol constraints and teacher-controlled transport/market. Only task selector differs; no feature/schema/model/gate changes.
Official resolve_episode_seed removes config seed and preserves it in replay info; deployed actor receives legal observations/config only, never root replay/info/opponent private or future data.
Exact registration/freeze/pre-review and source Git blobs before first game; loader preflight compatibility, current installed engine+loader hash before dispatch.

Every game uses separate official Python process and output/trace path. Threads may schedule subprocesses but must not simulate environments or share actor/RNG state. At most two in-flight, no prequeued launches after observed error.

Single-use markers; attempts recorded before launch; stop refill on any process/error/audit/identity/isolation failure, drain and retain in-flight results; never retry or replace. Finish each whole seed before safety decision, never stop early for success.
Strictly 8seeds x3opponents x2seats x2arms =96; no extra filename panel because all96 already use official filename loader.

Targeted synthetic regressions cover exact pair grid, duplicate/missing/mismatched identity rejection, whole-seed bootstrap, nonpositive ratio denominators and exact gate boundaries; no new official game for regression.

statistics.primary: Mean paired student-minus-reference own net profit divided by mean reference net profit, not mean of pairwise percentages. Net profit is final minus initial cash.
statistics.cluster: Eight complete seed clusters; every resample retains all opponent-seat-arm pairs of each sampled seed. Equal seed weights.
statistics.primary_gate: 95percent ratio interval lower strictly greater than -0.02
statistics.opponent_guards: Each opponent mean relative net-profit delta >=-0.05 and match-score delta >=-0.05; equality passes. Point-estimate guards only.
statistics.denominator: Every reported reference denominator, including bootstrap draws, must be positive; otherwise leave ratio undefined and admission false. No silent dropping, clipping or epsilon division.
statistics.interpretation: Engineering retention tolerance, not superior performance. Eight clusters remain small regardless of20k draws; per-opponent observed guards are not population statistical noninferiority.

post_review: Independently check all attempted/completed tuples, identity hashes, raw replay final cash/rewards/status, trace and source bindings, audit coverage, safety-stop timing and zero retry.

Independently recompute all48pairs,8seed aggregates,3opponent summaries, W/D/L and match scores, primary ratio,20k whole-seed percentile interval and gates without relying only on production summarize.
Replay only four prespecified saved student-market games, at most2876official transitions; distinguish root all96 certificates from independent sample scope.
Check protected historic files and prior negative outcomes unchanged; only explicit complete-prefix append of two review documents at publication.
Report actual sample count and partial safety/failure stop without confirmatory inference if panel incomplete. No model change or new seed draw after result.
limitations: Plan only; actual new source, seeds and freeze require separate pre-review before execution.
Seed novelty is bounded by recorded local/public history and cannot prove unrecorded external novelty.
